description: The Integrated MARKAL-EFOM System: Évora (TIMES-Évora) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by CENSE - NOVA University Lisbon. The TIMES-Évora is a city specific energy system model, which comprehensively represent Évora municipality energy systems, focusing on energy use in residential and non-residential buildings, transport systems and other energy uses (e.g. public lighting, small-scale industry etc.). Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: annual. Spatial resolution: districts. Software: GAMS (CPLEX solver). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
